HOUSING AUTHORITY MINUTES - 09/03/14 - 7 PM

38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B

09:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 104
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
For record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR LACKEY, COMMISSIONERS DISPENZA, HOFBAUER, THOMPSON, BROWN, AND SANCHEZ
3. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S).
Staff Recommendation: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting. (Vote - Requires a majority to waive.)
4. CONSENT CALENDAR - PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
5. HA CONSENT CALENDAR:
5.1 1) Approve the Housing Authority of the City of Palmdale's 2013-2014 Annual Report prepared per Health and Safety Code Section 34328 and 34328.1; and 2) Authorize the Executive Director or his designee to submit to the State of California Department of Housing and Community Development. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
HA 5.1
5.2 Approve the Minutes from the previous meetings held June 4, 2014 (5pm), and June 4, 2014 (7pm). (Staff Reference: Authority Secretary Smith)
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under this Consent Calendar. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to approve.
HA 5.2
6. JOINT CC AND HA CONSENT CALENDAR (CC Item No. 9.1 and 9.2 and HA Item Nos. 6.1and 6.2):
6.1 City Council to 1) Approve Agreement No. A-4846, a Memorandum of Understanding with Habitat for Humanity of San Fernando/Santa Clarita Valleys, Inc. ("Habitat") for the purpose of negotiating terms and conditions of the conveyance of property to Habitat for the development of affordable housing for veterans and any financial assistance to be provided by the City; and 2) Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute all necessary documents. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve Agreement No. A-4846. (Vote - Requires a majority to approve.)
HA 6.1
6.2 Housing Authority to 1) Approve Agreement No. A-4846, a Memorandum of Understanding with Habitat for Humanity of San Fernando/Santa Clarita Valleys, Inc. ("Habitat") for the purpose of negotiating terms and conditions of the conveyance of property to Habitat for the development of affordable housing for veterans, and the financial assistance to be provided by the Authority; and 2) Authorize the Executive Director or his designee to execute all necessary documents. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve Agreement No. A-4846. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to approve.)
HA 6.2
7. JOINT CC AND HA PUBLIC HEARING (CC Item Nos. 10.1 and 10.2 and HA Item Nos. 7.1 and 7.2):
7.1 Public Hearing and consideration of: 1) City Council Resolution No. CC 2014-104 approving a Cooperation Agreement , Agreement No. A-4847 between the City of Palmdale (City) to the Housing Authority of the City of Palmdale (Housing Authority) for the purpose of: a) The proposed sale of real property by the City to the Authority, APN 3009-001-900; b) The proposed terms and conditions of sale of such real property; c) the proposed terms and conditions of the Authority's payment of City fees for development of the property; and d) To authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute all necessary documents and take all necessary actions to implement the Agreement. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
7.1a ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2014-104, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE APPROVING AND AUTHORIZING A COOPERATION AGREEMENT WITH THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE REGARDING THE ACQUISITION OF PROPERTY LOCATED AT THE NORTHEAST CORNER OF EAST AVENUE R AND DIVISION STREET (APN 3009-001-900).
Staff Recommendation: Move to close the Public Hearing. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to close.) Move to adopt Resolution No. CC 2014-104. (Vote - Requires a majority to adopt.)
HA 7.1
7.2 Public Hearing and consideration of: 1) Housing Authority Resolution No. HA 2014-006 approving a Cooperation Agreement, Agreement No. A-4847 between the Housing Authority of the City of Palmdale (Authority) and the City of Palmdale (City) for the purpose of: a) The proposed sale of real property by the City to the Authority, APN 3009-001-900; b) The proposed terms and conditions of sale of such real property; c) the proposed terms and conditions of the Authority's payment of City fees for development of the property; and d) To authorize the Executive Director or his designee to execute all necessary documents and take all necessary actions to implement the Agreement. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
7.2a ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. HA 2014-006, A RESOLUTION OF THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE APPROVING AND AUTHORIZING A COOPERATION AGREEMENT WITH THE CITY OF PALMDALE REGARDING THE ACQUISITION OF PROPERTY LOCATED AT THE NORTHEAST CORNER OF EAST AVENUE R AND DIVISION STREET (APN 3009-001-900).
Staff Recommendation: Move to close the Public Hearing. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to close.) Move to adopt Resolution No. HA 2014-006. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to adopt.)
HA 7.2
8. PUBLIC COMMENTS:
9. ADJOURNMENT:
